column1: # S2 benchmark prompt set. One prompt per line: <id><TAB><text>. Lines starting with # are comments.
# The "system" line is the system instruction for every prompt. Each prompt is a fresh single-turn chat.
# Keep every prompt well under 200 tokens (PRD feature doc model-runtime.md, test plan item 2).

column2: You are Bibi, a friendly assistant on the user's phone. Answer in plain English, in at most three short sentences.
What is a good way to start my morning if I want more energy?
Give me three ideas for a quick, healthy lunch.
How do I boil an egg so the yolk is still soft?
What's the difference between weather and climate?
Suggest a name for a small orange kitten.
How can I fall asleep faster tonight?
Explain what a battery's mAh rating means.
Write a short, polite text telling my friend I'll be ten minutes late.
What are two tips for keeping my phone's battery healthy?
How many minutes are there in a week? Show the math briefly.
Give me a simple stretch I can do at my desk.
What does "offline first" mean for an app?
Remind me how to convert Celsius to Fahrenheit.
Suggest a fun indoor activity for a rainy afternoon with kids.
How do I politely decline a meeting invitation?
What is photosynthesis, in one or two sentences?
Give me a quick packing checklist for a weekend trip.
Why is the sky blue?
Write a one-line birthday wish for my sister.
How long should I steep green tea?
What is a good habit for saving a little money each week?
Explain the difference between RAM and storage on a phone.
How can I make my to-do list less overwhelming?
Give me a short motivational sentence for studying.
What should I do if I feel stressed before an exam?
Summarize this note in one sentence: "Buy milk, eggs and bread. Pick up the dry cleaning before six. Call the dentist to move Thursday's appointment to next week. Water the plants on the balcony."
Rewrite this more politely: "Send me the report now, I've been waiting all day."
Turn this into a short shopping list: "We're out of rice, the coffee is almost gone, and we need something for dinner on Friday, maybe pasta and tomatoes."

My friend wrote: "Hey, are you free on Saturday? A few of us are going hiking near the lake in the morning and then having lunch in town. No pressure if you're busy!" Write a short friendly reply saying yes.

Here is a paragraph: "Small language models can run on phones without the internet. They are slower and less knowledgeable than large cloud models, but they keep your data on the device and work anywhere." What is the main advantage it describes?
What is a good way to remember people's names?
Give me a two-sentence bedtime story about a moon and a cat.
How do I set a healthy screen-time limit for myself?
What's the capital of Canada, and one fact about it?
Suggest a quick ten-minute workout without equipment.
How do I clean a laptop keyboard safely?
Explain what an alarm and a timer are for, and when to use each.
What are three things to check before a long drive?
Give me a tip to drink more water during the day.
How do I write a good subject line for an email?
I have chicken, rice, onions and a lemon. What could I cook tonight?
Help me plan my evening: I need to cook dinner, answer two emails, do thirty minutes of reading, and I want to be in bed by eleven. It is now six o'clock. Give a short schedule.
What is the difference between a virus and bacteria?
Suggest a short, kind message to a coworker who is feeling unwell.
How can I focus better when working from home?
What is compound interest, explained simply?
Recommend a calm way to spend a Sunday morning.
Read this and tell me the date and time: "The parent-teacher meeting has been moved from Tuesday the 4th to Thursday the 6th at 5:30 pm in room 12. Please bring the signed form."
Give me two ways to reduce food waste at home.
Say goodnight to me in a cheerful way.
